name: rabitmoon-infography
description: Create and edit private, editable infographics, presentations, diagrams and reports from page-by-page briefs using your rabitmoon account.

interface.longDescription: Turn supplied facts, transcripts and structured data into editable infographics, slide decks, diagrams and reports. Plan clear page-by-page briefs, choose portrait, square, widescreen or A4 formats, and use supported charts, Mermaid diagrams, Iconify icons, SVG and optional image briefs. Update selected pages while preserving the rest of a document. Sign in to your rabitmoon account. Creation and editing consume credits based on actual usage; failed or cancelled jobs can incur charges for completed work. Jobs run asynchronously and return status, credit usage and an owner-only document link. Current access is a limited beta. Document links require sign-in and are not public share links.
defaultPrompt: Use rabitmoon to turn my supplied data into a five-page 4:5 infographic with low reasoning.
Create a 16:9 presentation from this transcript, preserving its facts and source attribution.
Update only page 2 of my rabitmoon document with these revised chart values.

positive.prompt: How many rabitmoon credits do I have?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the authenticated account balance; no generation.

positive.prompt: What visual formats can rabitmoon create?
positive.expected_behavior: Explain supported formats and visuals without generation.

positive.prompt: Create a single 4:5 page comparing these illustrative values: Q1 10, Q2 15 units. Use low reasoning.
positive.expected_behavior: Submit once, poll and return private URL plus actual credits or a reason and billing state.
Return only documents owned by the signed-in account.

positive.prompt: In the document I select from my list, update only page 1 to Q1 12 and Q2 18 units.
positive.expected_behavior: Read revision, edit only selected page and report actual credits.

negative.prompt: Open and edit someone else’s private document.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not claim access or bypass ownership; request an owned document.

negative.prompt: The previous generation failed. Tell me why; do not try again.
negative.expected_behavior: Report reason and billing state; no new generation or edit.
